exempt.cmd/metasystem: thin verb wiring exercised end to end by the shell fixtures
exempt.internal/refusal: declarative refusal types, constants, and register data contain no executable production statements; completeness tests independently join every row
exempt.internal/testutil: test-only subprocess installation support exercised by the importing packages' wait tests
exempt.internal/ui/httpd/walkthrough: manual UI walkthrough harness, not shipped engine code: package main (main.go, partner.go, smoke.go) with no test files, imported by no module package and built by no gate or build script; it serves the committed interface bundle over a canned ledger and a fakeacp partner for browser inspection, while the production handlers it drives are measured and floored in their own internal/ui packages

note: Per-package coverage floors; they only rise between re-seeds. Procedures (go-production-grade Phase 0c): a package split or rename re-seeds the affected entries at their measured post-change values in the same commit, with the rationale in that commit's message; composition changes (code added to or deleted from a package) re-baseline the same way. These floors are darwin measurements; linux floors live in coverage-ratchet-linux.json, seeded at production-grade Phase 1 by the two-pass bootstrap (pass one: full gate with METASYSTEM_COVERAGE_RATCHET_SEED=1, floors written from that run; pass two: the enforcing gate as the acceptance run). The cmd exemption's reason is recorded in exempt.
